title: Minimum Number of Refueling Stops

monster.name: Wasteland Marauder
monster.title: Siphoner of Fuel Depots
monster.defeatQuote: Minimum stops to reach target mileage without running dry!

description: A car travels from position 0 to `target`. It starts with `startFuel` liters of fuel. Each station `stations[i] = [positioni, fueli]`. What is the least number of refueling stops the car must make to reach its destination? If impossible, return -1.
starterCode:
def minRefuelStops(target: int, startFuel: int, stations: list[list[int]]) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def minRefuelStops(target: int, startFuel: int, stations: list[list[int]]) -> int:
    import heapq
    pq = []
    curr_fuel = startFuel
    stops = 0
    stations.append([target, 0])
    for pos, fuel in stations:
        while pq and curr_fuel < pos:
            curr_fuel += -heapq.heappop(pq)
            stops += 1
        if curr_fuel < pos: return -1
        heapq.heappush(pq, -fuel)
    return stops
hints: Drive as far as possible. When running out of fuel before next station, retroactively take the largest fuel available from visited stations.
